# FDG2004

> DO make sure that the API design specification is the central part of the design of any feature that includes a publicly accessible API.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 2.2.1 The Principle of Scenario-Driven Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: the rule text scopes it to features that include a publicly accessible API. A design-process rule; not machine-checkable.
